protocol.positive_edges: train positives for optimization; validation/test positives for evaluation only
protocol.negative_sampling: source-matched directed non-edges; every observed directed edge excluded
protocol.per_source_metrics: validation and test; pooled validation threshold reused for every source
protocol.threshold_selection: validation-only maximum F1 among non-trivial thresholds
protocol.test_protocol: single evaluation after early stopping on validation

threshold_selection.criterion: maximum F1 among thresholds that predict at least one negative

baseline_comparison.selection_criterion: highest validation average precision, then validation ROC-AUC
